d.g: The sound of an engine, especially when it is revving up.
d.x: I never saw my uncle’s Ferrari, but I could always hear it going vroom as it flew past by my house.

d.g: The sound of an engine revving up.
d.x: Our ears are assaulted with the screeching of tires, the crashing of trash cans, the exaggerated vrooms of a revving engine.

d.g: To move with great speed; to zoom.
